checkpoints.name: ERROR_HANDLING
checkpoints.evidence:
try:
    build_merchant_performance(spark, f"{silver_path}/date={run_date}", f"{gold_output_dir}/merchant_performance", run_date)
    build_customer_ltv(spark, f"{silver_path}", f"{gold_output_dir}/customer_ltv")
    build_daily_summary(spark, f"{silver_path}/date={run_date}", f"{gold_output_dir}/daily_summary", run_date)

    # Write run metadata to JSON
    with open(f"{gold_output_dir}/run_metadata.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(run_metadata, f)

except Exception as e:
    run_metadata["status"] = "FAILURE"
    run_metadata["error"] = str(e)
    with open(f"{gold_output_dir}/run_metadata.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(run_metadata, f)
    raise e
